decisions.decision: AlertStatus shape = two sustain counters (active_sustain_count + clear_sustain_count), not one
decisions.rationale: Pitfall 2 (sticky-bit recovery never fires) requires separate active/clear tracking; one-counter shape would reset on every poll and never accumulate the clear side

decisions.decision: recovery_subtype kwarg lives inside 15-01 fire_recovery signature, not a 15-02 amendment
decisions.rationale: Owner of the alerts.py helper is 15-01; adding the kwarg there prevents files_modified frontmatter drift in 15-02

decisions.decision: SSE payload for system_conditions is exactly 5 scalar fields: role, label, tier, state, since_ms
decisions.rationale: UI-SPEC locks the shape; no free-form message/last_seen/subtype fields leak into the channel

decisions.decision: Frontend Health rendering uses Alpine x-for template, not vanilla getElementById/innerHTML
decisions.rationale: Mirrors existing sortedHardware() pattern at index.html:396-404; keeps state model coherent across the dashboard
